ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) to high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels, with high-intensity pixels localized primarily along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity stippling and diffuse light-gray mottling concentrated along the upper 20-30% of both fluke lobes, with distinct white clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical pixel depth equivalent to roughly 10% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations across the entire span; right lobe (viewer right) contains three distinct high-amplitude irregular valleys (notches) between the center and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward-sweeping curves on both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips oriented dorsally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, circular white/beige pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme terminal ends of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, thin, light-gray linear tracks visible on the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe, oriented at roughly a 30-degree angle from the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle clusters on the distal tips; several irregular concave segments missing from the trailing edge of the right lobe indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated high-intensity white pixel cluster located at the base of the median notch.
